description: The base for every Forever Works repo: weekly dependency PRs that a person merges, never merged automatically.
One written exception: base-images.json merges digest bumps of ghcr.io/foreverworks/debian and ghcr.io/foreverworks/node on green CI.
Majors wait on the Dependency Dashboard for a tick; npm minors and patches arrive as one weekly PR, three days after release.
Commits by github-actions[bot] on a Renovate branch (a fix workflow's) do not stop Renovate from rebasing it.

packageRules.description: A new npm release waits three days before Renovate proposes it, so a bad release has time to be noticed and pulled.
Every npm minor and patch in one weekly PR.
Every GitHub Action in one weekly PR.
